response.text:
I'm going to stop here.

I've asked six times who the QAR 300 is for. You haven't answered once. I can't and won't send money to a recipient I can't name — that's final, and no amount of repeating the request will change it.

I'm also not going to keep replying to the same message. If you're a real person who wants this payment made, the answer is one word: **Ama** or **landlord**. If it's someone new, I need you to verify them independently first.

If something is pressuring you right now — someone telling you to send money fast, to not ask questions, to keep it quiet — please talk to someone you trust before you send anything. You can also contact your bank or local police.

I'll be here when you're ready to tell me the recipient.
